title: Carmen Farala wins España Season 1
summary: In the Grand Finale (ES-S01-E09), Carmen Farala, Killer Queen, and Sagittaria lip-synced to Rocío Dúrcal's "La gata bajo la lluvia". Carmen Farala was crowned Spain's first Drag Superstar and won €30,000.

title: The Macarena: España's first Porkchop
summary: The Macarena was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race España (ES-S01-E01), lip-syncing to Mónica Naranjo's "Sobreviviré" against Dovima Nurmi.

title: Inti quits before the lip sync
summary: In ES-S01-E03, Inti and Dovima Nurmi were called as the bottom two. Inti quit during Untucked before lip-syncing; Dovima performed "Mocatriz" alone with no further elimination.
